# tinyproctor.js

> Minimal, self-hosted, dependency-free browser integrity monitoring for online exams.
> One static JS file + one collector endpoint you implement. MIT license. v1.1.0.

This file is the implementation contract for AI agents integrating tinyproctor.js.

## Files

- Library (minified, ~21 KB raw / under 7 KB gzipped): https://tanzir71.github.io/tinyproctorjs/tinyproctor.min.js
- Library (readable source): https://tanzir71.github.io/tinyproctorjs/tinyproctor.js
- TypeScript types: https://tanzir71.github.io/tinyproctorjs/tinyproctor.d.ts
- Human docs: https://tanzir71.github.io/tinyproctorjs/docs.html
- Changelog: https://github.com/tanzir71/tinyproctorjs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- Repo: https://github.com/tanzir71/tinyproctorjs

## Integration steps

1. Download tinyproctor.min.js and serve it from the project's own static assets (same origin preferred; no CDN required).
2. Add this tag to the exam/quiz page template (server-render the real IDs):

```html
<script src="/js/tinyproctor.min.js" data-tinyproctor
  data-endpoint="/collect"
  data-exam-id="EXAM_ID_HERE"
  data-attempt-id="ATTEMPT_ID_HERE"
  data-candidate-label="PSEUDONYMOUS_USER_ID"></script>
```

Monitoring auto-starts on load. No init call needed unless `data-autoinit="false"`.
Put the tag on EVERY page of a multi-page quiz with the same data-attempt-id: the
library keeps one session and one score per attempt across pages (sessionStorage, per tab).
When the attempt is submitted, call `TinyProctor.destroy(true)` to forget the saved session.

Bundlers: `import TinyProctor from 'tinyproctor'` (or the .mjs entry) never auto-starts;
call `TinyProctor.init({ endpoint, examId, attemptId, ... })`.

3. Implement the collector endpoint (POST, same origin or CORS-enabled).

## Collector contract

The client POSTs JSON batches (Content-Type: application/json by default; also sent via
navigator.sendBeacon on page close — accept both). With data-format="text" the same JSON
arrives as text/plain; with data-format="form" it arrives as payload=<urlencoded JSON>.
Parse the body as JSON regardless of content type. Respond 2xx to acknowledge; non-2xx
responses are retried with exponential backoff (at-least-once delivery). Dedupe on
(sessionId, seq): seq is a per-session counter that increases by 1 for every event, so a
gap in seq means events were lost.

Request body:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "clientVersion": "1.1.0",
  "kind": "batch",
  "sessionId": "tp_...",
  "examId": "...",
  "attemptId": "...",
  "candidateLabel": "...",
  "sentAt": "ISO-8601",
  "userAgent": "...",
  "language": "en-US",
  "screen": { "w": 1920, "h": 1080 },
  "timezoneOffsetMin": -360,
  "events": [
    {
      "seq": 12,
      "clientTime": "ISO-8601",
      "eventType": "session|heartbeat|visibility|focus|fullscreen|devtools|clipboard|contextmenu|print|idle|screen|automation|input|custom",
      "violationKey": "tab_hidden|window_blur|fullscreen_exit|devtools_key|devtools_resize|copy_attempt|cut_attempt|paste_attempt|context_menu|print_attempt|page_idle|multi_screen|automation_flag|drop_attempt|insert_burst|custom or null",
      "eventData": {},
      "pageUrl": "...",
      "visibilityState": "...",
      "hasFocus": true,
      "isFullscreen": false,
      "violationCount": 0,
      "integrityScore": 100
    }
  ]
}
```

Useful eventData fields:
- session: { resumed: bool, persisted: bool, gapMs: ms since the previous page of this attempt was last seen }
- visibility (visible) and focus (focused: true): { awayMs: how long the candidate was away; 0 if still away }
- visibility with { unload: true }: the page was unloading (next quiz page, reload). Not a violation.
- insert_burst: { inputType, chars, targetTag } — the length only, never the text.

Store at minimum: attemptId, sessionId, seq, clientTime, eventType, violationKey,
integrityScore, violationCount, eventData (JSON), received_at. Index by attemptId.
Unique key: (sessionId, seq).

Validation recommendations: verify attemptId belongs to an active attempt,
rate-limit per session, cap body at ~1 MB (batches are capped at 48 KiB by default),
reject events for submitted/expired attempts.

Server-side flags worth computing: heartbeat gaps > 90 s, seq gaps, more than one sessionId
per attempt, large session gapMs between pages, attempts with no events at all.

CORS: only needed if collector origin differs from exam page origin. JSON bodies
(default) need an OPTIONS preflight: answer it with Access-Control-Allow-Origin (the exact
page origin), Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST, Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type.
sendBeacon always sends cookies, so also return Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true and
never "*" as the origin. To avoid preflight entirely, use data-format="text" (text/plain is
CORS-safelisted).

## Key config (data-* attributes on the script tag)

- data-endpoint (required for reporting) — collector URL
- data-exam-id, data-attempt-id (recommended; enables cross-page sessions), data-candidate-label
- data-silent (default true; false shows a live score badge)
- data-heartbeat-ms (default 30000)
- data-idle-ms (default 60000), data-idle (default true)
- data-clipboard / data-contextmenu / data-print / data-devtools (default true)
- data-screens (default true) — multi_screen via screen.isExtended (Chromium; no permission prompt)
- data-automation (default true) — automation_flag via navigator.webdriver
- data-insert (default true), data-insert-chars (default 40) — insert_burst threshold
- data-block-clipboard / data-block-contextmenu (default false — set true to prevent, not just detect; block-clipboard also blocks text drops)
- data-blur-dedupe-ms (default 0 = off) — e.g. 500 makes one tab switch count once (tab_hidden only)
- data-persist (default true when data-attempt-id is set) — false disables cross-page sessions
- data-batch-bytes (default 49152) — max bytes per POST
- data-weights — JSON, e.g. '{"tab_hidden":20,"paste_attempt":25}' (unlisted keys keep defaults)
- data-format — json (default) | text (text/plain, no CORS preflight) | form (payload=<urlencoded json>)
- data-autoinit="false" — then call TinyProctor.init({...}) yourself

## JS API (optional)

- TinyProctor.init(config) / TinyProctor.get() / TinyProctor.destroy(clearSession?)
- instance.getState() → { integrityScore, violationCount, violationCounts, recentViolations, seq, awayMs, resumed, ... }
- instance.markViolation(key, data) — custom violations
- instance.requestFullscreen(el) — call from a user gesture
- instance.clearSession() — forget the saved cross-page session
- config.onViolation(key, data, state) and config.onEvent(payload) callbacks

## Scoring

score = clamp(100 − Σ(weight × count), 0, 100). Default weights: tab_hidden 10,
window_blur 5, fullscreen_exit 25, devtools_key 20, devtools_resize 15,
copy_attempt 10, cut_attempt 10, paste_attempt 15, context_menu 5,
print_attempt 10, page_idle 5, multi_screen 10, automation_flag 25,
drop_attempt 15, insert_burst 15.

Note: a tab switch usually fires both tab_hidden and window_blur (15 points) unless
data-blur-dedupe-ms is set. Moving between form fields and moving to the next quiz page
are not violations.

Important: scores are triage signals for human review, not proof of cheating.
Never auto-fail a candidate from a client-side event alone.
